en: I entered that darts tournament I told you about, but lost to this guy in the finals. It was a pretty good game, though.
It was a great experience, though! Well, I'll see you in Nagasugai.
It was a great experience. Thanks for helping me practice.
What are you guys up to!?

(Uh-oh... Getting written up by the police could cause
　problems for the company. Better make a run for it!)
The chase will begin 10 seconds into the battle.
(I'll come back when I'm alone.)
Excuse me, sir!
Hm? What is it?
We're looking for someone to playtest our newly developed, state-of-the-art gaming experience.
Would you care to give it a try?
Sorry, but I don't have time to play games.
But wait! This game is like none other you've ever experienced before!
It's the latest version of Inner Fighter, developed by Doctor Minamida, the most brilliant scientist of our age!
I'm his assistant, as you can probably tell.
Doctor Minamida... The name does sound familiar.

Now, take a gander at the latest version of Inner Fighter!
We call it Inner Fighter 8: Road Battle, or IF8 for short!

However, the game is still in development. We need data from
actual players to finish up the testing phase. Otherwise, we
have no way of knowing how playable it actually is.
So, will you be our guinea pi⑬ Er, beta tester?
How about taking IF8 for a spin?
Okay, let me explain how this works.
IF8 lets you play what we call Road Battles. Basically you walk through a town, fighting enemies until you reach their boss.
Beating said boss will boost your abilities.
Unfortunately, we still lack a lot of input on level design, so the game isn't playable in its entirety just yet.
Once we collect a little more data, you'll be able to play all sorts of different stages.

Oh, and as I mentioned before, IF8 is still in its beta
build. There are still some costs we have to work out before
we can implement the rest of its intended features.
That's why we're hoping you'll invest in its completion. Developing such things is an expensive endeavor, after all.
Of course, there's something in it for you, too. Once the system is complete, it will be able to feed back a variety of data to you.
So please, think about it. Eheheh...
Did I mention it costs 10,000 yen to play a game? It's a little steep, but well worth it.
Well, would you like to play?
Okay, now select the stage you wish to play.
Nagasugai it is. That will be 10,000 yen please.
Okay, then let the Road Battle begin! Bon voyage!
Kamurocho it is. That will be 10,000 yen please.
Okay, gear up and get ready for ragin' Road Battle action!
I guess money's a little tight, huh? Sorry, but I'm going to have to ask you to come back when you can pay.
IF8 development is quite expensive. Would you like to invest in its completion?
Oh, you're really going through with it? You're wonderful!
Total investments so far have reached %s. How much will you contribute?
I think this is enough to upgrade IF8 to our latest version.
It will just take a moment.
All done! IF8 version 1.1 is now complete!
You can now play the Kamurocho stage, thanks to the upgrade.
I really hope you enjoy it. Well, see you again.
Thank you for your contribution. Total investments have reached %s.
We need 100,000 yen to finish a new playable stage.
We'd really appreciate anything you can afford to part with.
All done! IF8 version 1.2 is now complete!
Version 1.2 lets you earn Soul Orbs by completing a stage.
However, you have to complete the same stage a number of times. I hope you'll give it a try.
By the way, this will be our final version. No need to invest any more money now. We really appreciate all your help!
We could add new features if we had 200,000 yen.
I guess money's a little tight. Sorry, but I'll have to ask you to come back when you're able to pay.
This is the final version, so no more updates.
Oh, that's too bad. I'll be here if you change your mind.
Please come again. I'll be waiting. Ehehe...
You don't want to invest in IF8? Ah, that's too bad.
(I'll come back when I'm by myself.)
Excuse me, young lady. Do you have a moment?
Um... I guess?
We're looking for someone to playtest our newly developed, state-of-the-art gaming experience. Would you like to give it a try?
Sorry, but I don't know much about games. Good luck, though.
No, please! Wait! This game is really quite revolutionary!
And the controls are very simple. I bet you could do it even if you've never played a game in your life.
Also, it was developed by our very own Doctor Minamida, the most brilliant scientist of our age. It's the latest version of Inner Fighter.
I'm his assistant, as you can probably surmise.
I take it you've heard of the doctor before? Good. Then you know he's not some wacky old kook. He's more of a... misunderstood inventor. Anyway. On to the game.

This is the latest version of Inner Fighter! We call it
Inner Fighter 8: Road Battle, or IF8 for short!

Still not interested? Well, we added a brand new feature
that just might sway your opinion, methinks.

Have you ever wanted to be a magical girl who could cast
spells and gracefully topple thugs with the twirl of a wand?
Well now you <Italic>can</Italic>!
Hmm... That does sound kinda fun.
Right!? Who wouldn't want to do stuff like that? IF8's a dream machine designed to make your fantasies come true!

More than that, playing it can even draw out your potential
as an idol. Oh yes indeed.
Wait, how did you know I'm trying to be an idol?
How could I not? I never miss an airing of the Princess League. You're Haruka Sawamura-san, right?
Well, Haruka-san, you have everything to gain and nothing to lose by playing IF8!
So please... think about it. Eheheh...
Tsukimino it is. That will be 10,000 yen please.
Sotenbori it is. That will be 10,000 yen please.
Sotenbori B it is. That will be 10,000 yen please.
Kineicho it is. That will be 10,000 yen please.
Beatdown 100 it is. That will be 10,000 yen please.
Hairy Scary Bear it is. That will be 10,000 yen please.
You can now play the Kamurocho stage thanks to the upgrade.

However, you have to complete the same stage
a number of times. I hope you'll give it a try.

By the way, this will be our final version. No
need to invest any more money now. We really
appreciate all your help!
A little light in the wallet, are we? Please come back when your financial situation improves.
Ooh, you lost. That's too bad.
But, aheh, I hope you'll try again.
Congrats on winning that one.
I see you've earned an ability boost. That will provide us with some valuable data.
<Color:9>Your maximum Heat Gauge increased.<Color:Default>
You earned a Soul Orb thanks to the upgrade.
<Color:9>You earned one Soul Orb.<Color:Default>
Your abilities have been enhanced as far as they can go. Here's a prize instead.
Your abilities can't go any higher with this version. Here's a prize instead.
You got <Color:8>Snowman Hammer<Color:Default>.
You got <Color:8>Gravity Converter<Color:Default>.
You got a <Color:8>Staminan Royale<Color:Default>.
You got <Color:8>Mystery Liquid<Color:Default>.
You got <Color:8>Small Motor<Color:Default>.
Hahaha! Found you!
Santa! Do you have presents? I want a present!
*pant* Arrrgh! I'm done with this Santa thing!
(Good thing I got away from all that...)
Hey Santa, got some presents for us?
Ah, you must be the Santa hunters. I been lookin' for you.
You found us, old Nick! And we're so happy to see you... our third Santa today!
We're the town's best Christmas carolers! Bashing your head in the snow... in a one-horse open slay... O'er the killing fields we go, laughing all the way!
Why're ya doin' this?
Trust me, we're just doing what everyone else wishes they could do. Who isn't sick of all this Christmas shit every fucking year?
Yeah, just look at what you're wearin', man. Fuckin' stupid...
Ain't ya got girlfriends or somethin'?
Shut up! Just shut the hell up.
Too bad your girlfriend won't be here to wash the blood out of your dinky suit!
Stop, stop! We're sorry! Real sorry!
Let me sing you a carol now. "He's makin' a list, and checkin' it twice. Gonna find out who's naughty or nice..."
Santa Claus is coming to tooown!
You kids! Like I said, I ain't got nothin' for ya.
Come onnn! You're Santa, how could you not have presents?
I'm all out. Well... 'cept for these things here, I guess.
Wait, those are ours...
Wow, baseball bats! Just what I wanted!
Sports fan, huh? Take as many as ya like, then.
I want this thing over here, Santa!
Nunchaku? Ya like kung fu?
Yeah! I watch kung fu movies all the time! Hi-yah!
Not my nunchaku! They cost me a fortune!
Seems fair to me. The kids could use some real Christmas cheer after you takin' it from them all season.
If ya got a problem with that, though, I'm all ears. Your call.
Uh, it's okay... Go ahead, little bros, take all you want...
Yay! This is the best Christmas ever! Thanks, Santa!
Heh, I could get used to this Santa gig. Merry Christmas, everyone!

Oh, hi, Akiyama-san. Ya got a minute? I was hopin' to talk
to you about Haruka.
To me? What about?
Don't tell Haruka, but I think she might have a stalker...
Something happen?

We were walkin' back to her apartment late the other night,
and I caught some weirdo was followin' us.

I don't think Haruka noticed, but after saying goodnight,
I came back out, and that same guy was still there, watchin'
from a distance.
What happened then?

I was scared, but I went towards him to get a better look at
his face, and he took off runnin'. I figured he must've been
spyin' on Haruka.
Interesting. Has anything like this ever happened before?

There's plenty of wacky people with all sorts of crazy ideas
if Haruka's fan letters are anything to go by. There's no
end to them.

But this time, the stalker knows where Haruka lives. That's
what worries me.

Our agency has neither the staff nor the money
to keep watch over Haruka 24/7. Still, it's not exactly
something we can just ignore.

So, I was hoping to ask a favor of you. Would you mind
takin' a look around Haruka's apartment building every so
often? Just when you have time.

If you spot anyone sneakin' around, I'd like you to give 'em
a stern talking-to.

Sure, but I think you might be a little too optimistic if
you think that'll be enough to scare them off.
But it's worth a try. I might be just the man for the job.
I'm counting on you, Akiyama-san.
...So what was this all about?
Gentlemen, would you care to explain, please?

I... I'm not a stalker. I admit I found Haruka-chan's
apartment, and I hung around hopin' I could maybe see her.

But then I noticed there was this shifty guy hangin' around
there, as well, so I told myself I had to protect her. It was
some guy in a tracksuit.

Wait! That's the same as me! I saw this brute sniffin'
around Haruka-chan's place! She needed protectin' from him!

I saw that creep in the suit actin' all kinds of
suspicious. I was just tryna keep Haruka-chan safe!
All right, all right! I've heard enough!

Basically, all three of you are whistling the same tune⑬you
all tried to keep Haruka-chan from a stalker, and you all
got mistaken for one.

Pfft. What a mixed-up bunch of white knights. How silly can
ya get!?

Well, it's a good thing it wasn't serious. These guys seem
harmless enough⑬just some fans who took things a little too
far.

Sure caused us enough worry, though. You stay away from
Haruka's place from now on. If I see ya again, I'm callin'
the cops!
It won't happen again!
Please forgive us!
Sorry for causin' ya trouble!

Phew... Thanks for clearing this up, Akiyama-san. I suppose
I should thank you, huh? How about this?
You got a <Color:8>Royal Joker Card<Color:Default>.
You got 2,200 experience points.

(Wow, seriously? Guy's none too secret about being a
stalker, is he?)
Excuse me, pal. Mind telling me what you're up to?
Wha...? Who are you?
I'm with Dyna Chair. Ring a bell?
You're from Haruka-chan's agency!?
Yep. So, let me ask you again⑬what are you doing here?
Uh, well, you see, I... Nothin'! Later!
Hey! Stop!

All right. I'll ask you nicely⑬quit skulking around
Haruka-chan.
Stalking is an actual crime. You know that, right?

You got it all wrong! I'm no stalker! I was just tryin' to
keep Haruka-chan safe...
Sure, pal, that's what they all say.
I swear, I'm not lyin'! Haruka-chan really is bein' stalked!
